name: Ali Hamza
title: Software Engineer
headline: C# | ASP.NET Core | MVC | REST API | WinForms | PHP | HTML | CSS
summary: Software Engineer with experience designing and delivering enterprise applications, real-time monitoring systems, and data-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and support informed decision-making. Committed to building scalable, reliable, and maintainable software with a strong focus on performance, quality, and user experience. Passionate about solving complex business challenges through innovative solutions while continuously learning and contributing to high-impact projects in collaborative environments.

points: Design and maintain scalable web and desktop applications using ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC and WinForms.
Built a RESTful API for traffic junction monitoring with token authentication, live junction status and alarm management (ASP.NET Core Web API, EF Core, MySQL).
Work with microscopic traffic simulation environments to model road networks, analyse vehicle flow and evaluate signal timing strategies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, high-availability systems for enterprise and government projects.
Developed and maintained web application features with PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
